limitations: Seed batch; coverage is incomplete and will expand on continuation.
Only explicitly sourced friendship labels appear; no claim that this enumerates anyones closest friends.
Shared employer, event attendance, investor lists and leadership rosters alone do not create person relationships.
Cofounding partnerships establish a professional relation; personal closeness remains unknown unless explicitly sourced.
Historical roles are preserved as historical evidence, not current employment or current hiring authority.
Single-paper coauthorship is not admitted as a close edge. Repeated named small-team research is labeled research collaboration, not friendship.
Routes are best discovered policy-weight paths by exact hop count in this dataset, not globally shortest professional chains.
Policy weight products are heuristic ranking values, not calibrated probabilities.
A source-backed working relationship does not establish willingness to introduce or hire someone.
postgresql_import: Run seed.postgresql.sql. Reimports with the same identifiers do not duplicate records.
csv_null_semantics: Empty field represents SQL NULL. Booleans are true/false; array cells contain JSON.
online_query_rule: Resolve an exact person identity and verify the live-to-entry relationship. Then select a cached route to the actual desired target with hop_count <= 6 minus the online path hop count. Landing on any member of the same employer is not sufficient to claim the target is reached.
continuation: Use expansion_queue.csv, retain all IDs, append only newly supported records, update evidence and role observations, and rebuild route_cache. Focus next on recruiter/engineering-manager bridges and connections between disconnected components.

date_semantics.published_on: Exact source publication date, when verified; NULL if only the year is known.
date_semantics.publication_year: Source publication year; not a relationship start year.
date_semantics.observed_on: Dated source observation, not employment start. Undated source-observed roles use checked_on with checked_day precision; unknown historical dates remain NULL.
date_semantics.relationship_start_year: Actual start year only when verified; NULL represents unknown.

hiring_authority_semantics.talent_leadership_documented: Public evidence of an HR or people leadership role; does not establish authority for a particular open position.
hiring_authority_semantics.historical_hiring_decision_documented: First-person evidence of a specific past hiring decision; does not assert present hiring authority.

relationship_freshness: checked_on records source review, not reconfirmation of present friendship or employment. Historical edges require fresh verification before relying on them for an introduction.
